refinements.name: 财迷心窍
refinements.description: [强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]造成以太伤害时，所有单位对目标造成的伤害提升15%，装备者的能量自动回复提升0.5点/秒，持续2秒，同名被动效果之间不可叠加。
refinements.descriptionEn: Dealing Ether DMG using an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate increases all units' DMG against the target by 15% and increases the equipper's Energy Regen by 0.5/s for 2s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

basic.name: 普通攻击：狡兔连打
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的打击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：糖衣炮弹
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动远程打击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a ranged strike against enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：夹心糖衣炮弹
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Stuffed Sugarcoated Bullet
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动强力远程打击，并在目标处生成能量场，持续牵引敌人，造成以太伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，在炮口生成小型能量场，持续消耗能量并对近处的敌人造成额外伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
A powerful ranged strike, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal Ether DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] down to charge up this attack, during which a small energy field is generated at the muzzle as Energy is consumed, dealing bonus DMG to enemies nearby.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：牵制炮击
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向后闪避，并对前方敌人发动远程打击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Dodge backwards and send a ranged strike at enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

chain.name: 连携技：高价以太爆弹
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力远程打击，并在目标处生成能量场，持续牵引周围敌人，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful ranged strike at enemies in a small area, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

ultimate.name: 终结技：特制以太榴弹
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力远程打击，并在目标处生成能量场，持续牵引周围敌人，造成以太伤害；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复10点能量，下一名换入前场的角色额外回复20点能量；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful ranged strike at enemies in a small area, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal Ether DMG.
When using this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in gains an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：救急炮击
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向后闪避，并对前方敌人发动远程打击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：狡兔出手！
defensiveAssist.nameEn: Defensive Assist: The Hare Strikes Back!
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：趁虚而入
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方突进后对敌人发动炮击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge forward and bombard enemies, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cinema.name: 增压强化弹
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]造成的伤害和累积的属性异常积蓄值提升16%；发动[强化特殊技]时，每多蓄力0.1秒，在目标处生成的能量场持续时间提升0.15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: The DMG and the Anomaly Buildup inflicted by Nicole's EX Special Attack increases by 16%. For each additional 0.1s of charging when Nicole activates her EX Special Attack, the duration of the energy field created at the target location increases by 0.15s

cinema.name: 聚能装置
cinema.description: 触发[核心被动：机关箱]的减益效果时，妮可回复5点能量，15秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Nicole recovers 5 Energy when Core Passive: Mechanical Case's debuff is triggered. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

cinema.name: 狡兔智慧
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 领域扩增
cinema.description: 妮可发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]、[终结技]时，在目标处生成的能量场攻击范围提升，直径增加3米。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Nicole uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, the diameter of the energy field generated at the target location is increased by 3m.

cinema.name: 业界红人
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 侵蚀能量场
cinema.description: 能量场对敌人造成伤害时，所有单位对该目标的暴击率提升1.5%，最多叠加10层，持续12秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Nicole's energy fields deal DMG to an enemy, all units' CRIT Rate against that enemy increases by 1.5%, stacking up to 10 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：惊喜开箱
basic.nameEn: Dash Attack: Jack in the Box
basic.description:
拖曳摇杆发动闪避后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向对应方向冲刺，并对身周敌人进行打击，造成物理伤害；
未拖曳摇杆发动闪避后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向后躲避，并对前方敌人发动远程打击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
basic.descriptionEn:
When dragging the joystick during a dodge, press [Basic Attack]:
Dashes in the target direction and strikes nearby enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
When not dragging the joystick during a dodge, press [Basic Attack]:
Vaults backward and launches a ranged strike against enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance her Basic Attack and Dash Attack, up to 8 times.

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
103100004.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
A powerful ranged strike, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal Ether DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] down to charge up this attack, during which a small energy field is generated at the muzzle as Energy is consumed, dealing bonus DMG to enemies nearby.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

103100008.name: 连携技：高价以太爆弹
103100008.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力远程打击，并在目标处生成能量场，持续牵引周围敌人，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
103100008.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful ranged strike at enemies in a small area, generating an energy field that pulls enemies towards its center to deal Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

103100011.name: 快速支援：救急炮击
103100011.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向后闪避，并对前方敌人发动远程打击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后自动上弹并强化[普通攻击]与[冲刺攻击]，最多触发8次。
103100011.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodge backwards and send a ranged strike at enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Automatically reloads after the attack to enhance Basic Attack and Dash Attack up to 8 times.

103100004.name: 强化特殊技：夹心糖衣炮弹
103100004.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Stuffed Sugarcoated Bullet
